[HARMONIZE]!, the world’s top choir with 20 million views, who made us feel the national pride with a
busking of one of the soundtracks of Lion King at a restaurant in South Africa
The main vocalists of PURPLE KISS visit them to get the secret of harmony handed down to them...

But... unlike with the previous master, the mood at the scene turned cold?!
And then HARMONIZE had a head start on them...!
Can PURPLE KISS’s Go Eun, Chaein and SWAN successfully learn the secret of harmony from
HARMONIZE?
